resources.title: World English Bible
resources.description: A complete 66-book Bible with 31,098 verses. The same translation included with Selah, packaged for reference or a missing installation.
resources.instruction: Unzip, then use Libraries → Bible → Import translation. Already included in Selah; no reimport needed.

resources.title: The multilingual starter collection
resources.description: Five original demo songs, with verses, choruses, saved arrangements, and a bilingual English–Telugu example.
resources.instruction: Unzip, then import each JSON separately through Libraries → Songs → Import song.

resources.title: Amazing Grace
resources.description: A familiar hymn to try your first service. Three verses, credits, and a ready-to-use arrangement.
resources.instruction: Unzip, then use Libraries → Songs → Import song.

resources.title: Midnight lyrics
resources.description: A quiet dark layout for lyrics, with a song title and credit line.
resources.instruction: Use Libraries → Templates → Import. Select the saved layout when adding lyrics or Scripture.

resources.title: Warm paper scripture
resources.description: A light Scripture layout with generous text space, a passage reference, and translation label.
resources.instruction: Use Libraries → Templates → Import. Select the saved layout when adding lyrics or Scripture.

resources.title: Bilingual evening
resources.description: A paired-language layout that keeps primary lyrics and translation together.
resources.instruction: Use Libraries → Templates → Import. Select the saved layout when adding lyrics or Scripture.

resources.title: A Sunday, already taking shape
resources.description: A six-item service preset with welcome slides, Amazing Grace, Psalm 23, a message title, prayer, and announcements.
resources.instruction: Unzip, then use Programs → Import. Change the title, date, and content for your own service.
